title: Understanding Linear Separability
text: Consider what it means for a dataset to be linearly separable. Can you draw a straight line that separates the two classes without any misclassification?

title: Visualizing the Separation
text: Look at the distribution of the orange and blue points. Are they clustered in a way that a single straight line can separate them?

title: Checking for Linear Separability
text: Based on the image, can a straight line separate the orange and blue points without any overlap?
